_note: Descriptive, not aspirational. Every value here is checked against frontend/src/index.css, tailwind.config.js and the components. If you change the code, change this file — it is the design contract, not a wishlist.

identity.name: Yaduraj Singh
identity.differentiator: Production code at 20. Self-hosted infra. Live apps with real users.
identity.vibe: Code-first, confident builder, dark terminal meets Linear.

theme.usage: Always reference var(--bg), var(--surface), var(--border), var(--text), var(--accent) rather than literals, so light mode follows for free. Light mode is implemented as targeted utility overrides at the bottom of index.css — a new hardcoded zinc/black utility may need an override added there.

typography.loaded_via: <link> in frontend/public/index.html — never re-declare @import in CSS

hierarchy.h1: font-display text-[14vw] sm:text-[10vw] md:text-[88px] lg:text-[112px] leading-[0.92] font-medium text-white
hierarchy.h2: font-display text-4xl md:text-5xl tracking-tighter font-medium text-white

rules: Section titles and nav labels are lowercase. Prose is sentence case.
Every label, badge, metric key, timestamp and micro-caption is mono.
Section subtitles are slash comments: `// shipped & live`.
Ordinal indices are zero-padded and accent-coloured: 01, 02, 03.

layout.grid: md:grid-cols-12 for split sections; md:grid-cols-2 for the project grid
layout.radius: rounded-2xl cards, rounded-xl inner tiles, rounded-full pills and buttons

ui_elements.cards: rounded-2xl border border-white/[0.06] bg-[#0A0A0A] hover:border-white/20 transition-colors p-6 md:p-7
ui_elements.buttons_primary: bg-white text-black h-11 px-5 rounded-full font-medium text-sm hover:bg-zinc-200 transition-colors
ui_elements.buttons_ghost: bg-transparent text-zinc-300 border border-white/15 h-11 px-5 rounded-full font-mono text-sm hover:text-white hover:border-white/30 transition-colors
ui_elements.badges: px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-white/[0.08] bg-white/[0.015] text-[10.5px] font-mono text-zinc-400
ui_elements.live_dot: Green ping dot — a stacked animate-ping halo over a solid bg-[var(--accent)] dot. Used anywhere something is genuinely live.
ui_elements.section_header: components/SectionHeader.jsx — index + rule + `// subtitle`, then the title with an accent full stop.

sections_in_order.name: BootScreen
sections_in_order.details: First visit only, gated on sessionStorage `yr-booted`. Fake systemd boot log, 1.5s, then fades. Project and stack counts are derived from portfolio.json — never typed by hand.

sections_in_order.name: Navigation
sections_in_order.details: Fixed floating pill, backdrop-blur-xl, border/bg darken past 24px scroll. Holds section links, time-on-site, ⌘K trigger, ambient-audio toggle, theme toggle, mobile menu.

sections_in_order.name: Hero
sections_in_order.details: Full-height, grid-bg + radial accent spotlight. Scrambling name in Outfit at display size, tagline, `view work` + `download resume` (/cv), socials. Right column is the interactive LiveTerminal.

sections_in_order.name: Stats
sections_in_order.details: Four-up strip, pulled up over the hero fade with -mt-12. Values are display-size tabular numerals over mono labels.

sections_in_order.name: About — 01
sections_in_order.details: 12-col split. Large statement left, checklist of ABOUT_POINTS right.

sections_in_order.name: Now Building — 02
sections_in_order.details: Single highlighted card for the current product. Accent border, glow-border hover, sweeping press-feedback-card sheen, radial accent bloom, bullet tiles, mono `git status` footer line.

sections_in_order.name: Experience — 03
sections_in_order.details: Vertical timeline with accent ring nodes and a fading rule.

sections_in_order.name: Projects — 04
sections_in_order.details: FeaturedProject card (metrics grid + fake curl 200 OK line) followed by a 2-col grid of ProjectCards. Every card opens ProjectModal with the case study. Prose counts derive from PROJECTS.length.

sections_in_order.name: Tech Stack — 05
sections_in_order.details: Two columns of mono badge groups, each headed by a /slug-path label and a fading rule.

sections_in_order.name: Contact — 06
sections_in_order.details: Statement + big mailto left; phone (copy to clipboard, Sonner toast), GitHub, LinkedIn, portfolio rows right.

sections_in_order.name: Footer
sections_in_order.details: Agent-facing links (/about, /docs, /contact, /privacy, /llms.txt, /openapi.json) as plain <a> — real documents outside the SPA — over a mono echo line.

overlays: CommandPalette — ⌘K or `/`. Navigate, open any project, copy email/phone, open socials, toggle theme.
ProjectModal — case study: problem, approach, decisions, stack, metrics.
CursorSpotlight — accent radial that trails the cursor, disabled on (hover: none).

consumers: scripts/prerender.js -> no-JS content injected into build/index.html and build/404.html
data.rule: Add or edit content in the JSON only. Anything that restates a count in prose must derive it from the data, not repeat it.

motion.scroll: Native CSS scroll-behavior: smooth. No Lenis — do not add a scroll library.
motion.animations: components/Reveal.jsx — IntersectionObserver fade + 14px lift, cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), staggered by a delay prop. No framer-motion; the dependency is not installed and the CSS keyframes in index.css cover the rest.
motion.keyframes: revealUp, blink (cursor), marquee — all in index.css

accessibility_and_testing.requirements: data-testid on EVERY interactive element, e.g. data-testid='nav-about', data-testid='contact-copy-phone'.
accessibility_and_testing.agent_readability: The site is built to be readable without JavaScript. Any new section must also appear in scripts/prerender.js and scripts/gen-pages.js, or it exists for humans only.
accessibility_and_testing.checks: npm test (frontend) and npm run verify:agent-readiness -- <origin>
